instruction.text: Jill has 22 lollipops. Select the number 22 on the grid.

Her friend Gemma has 30 lollipops.
How many lollipops do they have altogether?
Count up from 22 and select the correct number on the grid.
Mandy collected 76 raspberries from her grandparents’ garden. Select the number 76 on the grid.

Mandy collects another 20 raspberries.
How many raspberries does Mandy have now?
Count up from 76 and select the correct number on the grid.
Jaden has 45 stickers. Select the number 45 on the grid.

Jaden gives his younger brother 10 stickers.
How many stickers does Jaden have now?
Count down from 45 and select the correct number on the grid.
Noah has 61 marbles. Select the number 61 on the grid.

Noah loses 50 marbles in the park.
How many marbles does Noah have now?
Count down from 61 and select the correct number on the grid.
